records.title: DCS Experience Outside North America
records.evidence_note: Harding cites Thornton as the source of five simple DCS cases across more than 12,000 trainee exposures in 1983–1987, with a stated rate of 0.41 per 1,000. The chapter reports anecdotal staff symptoms without formal reports. For 1988 it records three requests for advice on suspected DCS. For 1989 it says no cases were reported. A separate account of the 1988 RNZAF reports distinguishes one mild case from one arterial gas embolism.

records.title: Three Incidents of Decompression Illness at the RAF Centre of Aviation Medicine
records.evidence_note: Manton describes two training cases and one research case. The rotary student had constitutional DCI symptoms. A medical officer participating as a student had symptoms compatible with arterial gas embolism. The research participant developed limb pain DCS. All three received therapeutic hyperbaric treatment. The abstract gives no incident dates and no incidence risk set.

observations.note: Constitutional DCI symptoms as reported. The abstract does not give a specific DCS classification.

observations.group: Medical officer attending a training course
observations.note: The medical officer participated in a trainee role. The source describes symptoms compatible with AGE.
Limb pain DCS during an experimental study. No operational staff or trainee risk set.

records.title: DCS in the Swedish Air Force. A Survey and Experimental Study
records.evidence_note: The questionnaire concerns in-flight C-130 crew symptoms and provides no numerators or denominators. A separate chamber experiment detected venous bubbles and no arterial bubbles. None of the six experimental participants reported clinical DCS symptoms.

observations.note: The abstract gives six subjects. The denominator counts experimental participants and no role strata are reported.

note: Harding’s reference 2 and McLoughlin’s reference 3 give the same thesis. Faculty publications document a historical abstract database and accepted-dissertation library. No item-level holding or text was confirmed for Thornton.
